intent.raw_query: Bali for solo traveler, $1500 budget, beaches and yoga, July 2026 from LA

experiences.name: Sunrise Yoga at Campuhan Ridge Walk
experiences.description: Join an outdoor sunrise yoga session along the scenic Campuhan Ridge Walk in Ubud, surrounded by lush green hills and rice paddies. Many local instructors offer small group classes here, blending breathwork and asana with Bali's natural beauty.

experiences.name: Seminyak Beach Sunset & Surf Lesson
experiences.description: Take a beginner-friendly surf lesson on the golden sands of Seminyak Beach, one of Bali's most beautiful stretches of coastline. After your lesson, relax and watch the legendary Bali sunset with a fresh coconut in hand.

experiences.name: Multi-Day Yoga Retreat at The Yoga Barn
experiences.description: Spend several days immersed in Bali's most renowned yoga center, The Yoga Barn in Ubud. Choose from daily drop-in classes including Hatha, Vinyasa, Yin, and meditation. The lush jungle setting and world-class instructors make this a transformative experience.

experiences.name: Nusa Dua Crystal-Clear Beach Day
experiences.description: Spend a full day at the pristine, calm waters of Nusa Dua Beach, ideal for swimming and snorkeling. Rent a sun lounger, explore the coral reefs just offshore, and enjoy fresh grilled seafood from beachside warungs for a quintessential Bali beach experience.

experiences.name: Balinese Cooking Class & Tanah Lot Temple Visit
experiences.description: Start your morning with a traditional Balinese cooking class in Canggu, learning to prepare dishes like satay lilit and black rice pudding using fresh market ingredients. In the evening, visit the iconic sea temple of Tanah Lot perched on a rocky outcrop, especially magical at sunset.

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Bali
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

day_by_day.morning: No morning activities — flight arrives at 13:00. Rest and travel time.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Ngurah Rai International Airport at 13:00. Take a pre-booked airport shuttle or shared taxi (budget option ~IDR 150,000) to Campuhan Ridge, Ubud. Check in to Campuhan Ridge Ubud Boutique Stay, freshen up, and take a gentle orientation stroll along the iconic Campuhan Ridge Walk — a scenic 2 km ridge trail through lush green hills, free of charge and just steps from the hotel.
day_by_day.evening: Explore the nearby Jalan Raya Ubud main street on foot. Browse local warungs and small shops to get acquainted with the area. Watch the sunset from the ridge or a nearby café terrace.

meals.breakfast: Meal on the plane or skip — arrival is at 13:00.
meals.lunch: Grab a quick, affordable meal at a local warung near the hotel upon arrival — try Nasi Campur (mixed rice plate) for around IDR 25,000–40,000.
meals.dinner: Warung Babi Guling Ibu Oka or a simple local warung on Jalan Raya Ubud. Budget around IDR 40,000–60,000 for a hearty Balinese rice dish.

day_by_day.notes: Exchange some currency at the airport or use an ATM in Ubud. Avoid taxi touts at the airport — use a metered Blue Bird taxi or a pre-arranged shuttle for the safest and cheapest option. The Campuhan Ridge Walk is best in late afternoon when it cools down slightly.

day_by_day.morning: Start the day with a free sunrise yoga session on the hotel terrace or follow along with a YouTube yoga class in your room. Then take the Campuhan Ridge Walk again in the early morning mist (best time for photos and cooler temperatures). The walk takes about 1–1.5 hours at a leisurely pace.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the Saraswati Temple (Pura Taman Saraswati) in central Ubud — free to enter, small donation appreciated. Stroll through the Ubud Art Market (Pasar Seni Ubud) for budget souvenir shopping; bargain for local crafts, sarongs, and wooden items. Head to the Ubud Palace (Puri Saren Agung) nearby — free to view from outside.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a traditional Kecak Fire Dance performance at Pura Dalem Ubud or Arma Open Stage — tickets around IDR 100,000–150,000. This is a must-see cultural experience in Ubud.

meals.breakfast: Warung or hotel breakfast if included — or try a local café for banana pancakes and fresh fruit juice for IDR 30,000–50,000.
meals.lunch: Warung Sopa (vegetarian-friendly, very affordable) on Jalan Sudama — budget IDR 35,000–55,000.
meals.dinner: Warung Makan near the Ubud Market area — try Mie Goreng or Nasi Goreng for IDR 30,000–50,000.

day_by_day.notes: Wear a sarong when visiting temples (often provided at the entrance for a small fee or free). The Kecak Dance is performed at sunset, usually around 18:00 — book tickets in the afternoon to secure a spot.

day_by_day.morning: Join a budget-friendly group yoga class at one of Ubud's many yoga studios. Yoga Barn and Radiantly Alive offer drop-in classes from IDR 120,000–150,000. Choose a 7:00 or 8:00 AM class to start the day energized. Afterward, walk to the nearby Penestanan village for a quiet local neighborhood experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit Tegalalang Rice Terraces (about 15 minutes north of Ubud by scooter rental ~IDR 70,000/day). Walk the terraced paths and take in the stunning UNESCO-recognized landscape. There is a small voluntary donation at the entrance (IDR 10,000–20,000). Rent a scooter for the day to maximize mobility.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Ubud and browse the night market stalls near Ubud Market for local snacks and fresh fruit. Relax at the hotel or do a gentle evening stretching/yoga session.

meals.breakfast: Smoothie bowl or acai bowl at a local health café — IDR 45,000–70,000. Try Seniman Coffee Studio for great value.
meals.lunch: Warung at Tegalalang — simple rice and vegetable dishes with a view of the terraces, IDR 30,000–50,000.
meals.dinner: Warung Biah Biah on Jalan Goutama — authentic Balinese food at very affordable prices, IDR 40,000–60,000.

day_by_day.notes: Scooter rental is the most budget-friendly way to explore beyond Ubud. Ensure you have an international driving permit. Wear a helmet at all times. Tegalalang can get crowded mid-morning — arrive before 9:00 AM or after 3:00 PM for a quieter experience.

day_by_day.morning: Take a day trip to Tirta Empul Temple (Holy Spring Temple) — about 15 km from Ubud, accessible by scooter. This sacred Hindu temple features purification pools where locals and visitors can participate in a ritual water blessing (bring a sarong and be respectful). Entrance fee: IDR 50,000.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue to Kintamani for a stunning view of Mount Batur volcano and Lake Batur. The viewpoint is free. If budget allows, a simple warung lunch here with the volcanic view is a memorable experience. Return to Ubud in the late afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: Relax at the hotel. Do a self-guided meditation or yoga session using a free app. Enjoy the peaceful Campuhan Ridge area in the golden hour light.

meals.breakfast: Local warung near the hotel — nasi goreng with egg and tea, IDR 25,000–35,000.
meals.lunch: Warung at Kintamani with volcano views — expect to pay IDR 50,000–80,000 (slightly touristy pricing but worth it for the view).
meals.dinner: Cook-your-own or grab takeaway from a local warung near Campuhan — IDR 30,000–50,000.

day_by_day.notes: Tirta Empul is a deeply sacred site — dress modestly and follow all temple etiquette. The purification ritual is open to non-Hindus but should be approached with genuine respect. The road to Kintamani is uphill and winding — drive carefully on the scooter.

day_by_day.morning: Morning yoga class at The Yoga Barn (Ubud's most famous yoga center) — drop-in classes from IDR 120,000. Choose a Hatha, Vinyasa, or Yin session. The lush jungle setting makes this a special experience. Afterward, walk along the Wos River valley trail near the studio.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the Monkey Forest (Mandala Suci Wenara Wana) in central Ubud — entrance IDR 80,000. Spend 1–2 hours exploring the ancient temple complex and interacting with the resident long-tailed macaques. Keep valuables secured.
day_by_day.evening: Stroll down Jalan Hanoman and Jalan Dewi Sita — Ubud's most charming pedestrian-friendly streets with local boutiques, art galleries, and cafés. Enjoy the vibrant evening atmosphere.

meals.breakfast: Fresh tropical fruit plate and coconut water from a street vendor near the hotel — IDR 20,000–30,000.
meals.lunch: Warung Teges on Jalan Hanoman — local favorites at IDR 30,000–45,000.
meals.dinner: Locavore TO GO (the budget sister of the famous Locavore restaurant) — creative Indonesian street food at IDR 50,000–80,000.

day_by_day.notes: At the Monkey Forest, do not bring visible food — monkeys will snatch it. Keep sunglasses on your face, not on your head, as monkeys are attracted to shiny objects. The Yoga Barn schedule changes weekly — check their website the night before to book your preferred class.

day_by_day.morning: Take a guided or self-guided cycling tour downhill from Kintamani to Ubud — several budget operators offer this for IDR 200,000–300,000 including transport to the top, bike, helmet, and breakfast. The 30 km downhill route passes through rice fields, traditional villages, and local markets.
day_by_day.afternoon: Rest at the hotel after the morning activity. Enjoy the pool or garden area. Do a restorative yoga session or nap. Alternatively, visit the small but charming Neka Art Museum in Campuhan (near the hotel) — entrance IDR 75,000 — to learn about Balinese painting traditions.
day_by_day.evening: Walk to the Campuhan Ridge at sunset for golden hour views. This is one of the most romantic and peaceful spots in Ubud and it is completely free.

meals.breakfast: Included with the cycling tour — typically a local Balinese breakfast at a village home.
meals.lunch: Warung near the hotel on return — Gado-Gado (peanut sauce salad) or Soto Ayam (chicken soup), IDR 25,000–40,000.
meals.dinner: Warung Ibu Oka 2 or a nearby warung in Campuhan area — IDR 40,000–60,000.

day_by_day.notes: The cycling tour is one of the best budget experiences in Bali — book the night before with a local operator to get the best price. Wear sunscreen and bring a light rain jacket as mornings can be misty at higher altitudes.

day_by_day.morning: Day trip to the beach! Take a shared shuttle or public bemo (local minibus) to Seminyak or Canggu beach (about 1.5–2 hours from Ubud). Budget shuttles cost around IDR 50,000–80,000 one way. Arrive at the beach by mid-morning and enjoy the warm Indian Ocean waters.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon at the beach — swim, sunbathe, and take in the surf culture of Canggu. Batu Bolong Beach in Canggu is free to access and less crowded than Seminyak. Watch local surfers and consider a beginner surf lesson (IDR 150,000–200,000 for a 1-hour group lesson).
day_by_day.evening: Catch the famous Bali sunset from the beach — one of the most spectacular in Southeast Asia. Take a shared shuttle back to Ubud in the evening.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at the hotel or a warung before departure — nasi goreng or toast with local jam, IDR 25,000–40,000.
meals.lunch: Beachside warung at Canggu — fresh grilled fish, rice, and vegetables for IDR 50,000–75,000.
meals.dinner: Quick warung dinner in Ubud on return — IDR 35,000–55,000.

day_by_day.notes: Book your return shuttle in advance at the beach or through your hotel to avoid being stranded. Canggu has strong waves — swim only in designated safe zones marked by flags. Bring reef-safe sunscreen to protect Bali's marine ecosystem.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery morning after the beach day trip. Start with a gentle morning yoga session on the hotel terrace or in your room. Then take a slow walk through the Penestanan artist village near Campuhan — a peaceful neighborhood full of local painters' studios and organic cafés.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit Pura Gunung Lebah temple at the bottom of the Campuhan Ridge — a beautiful and quiet riverside temple that is free to visit (small donation welcome). Spend time meditating by the river. Afterward, explore the local Campuhan area on foot.
day_by_day.evening: Treat yourself to a budget spa treatment — traditional Balinese massage is available throughout Ubud for IDR 80,000–120,000 for a 60-minute session. Look for small local spas rather than hotel spas for the best prices.

meals.breakfast: Café Pomegranate or similar organic café in Penestanan — healthy breakfast bowl for IDR 45,000–65,000.
meals.lunch: Warung in Penestanan village — home-cooked local meal for IDR 25,000–40,000.
meals.dinner: Warung near Campuhan Ridge — try Bebek Betutu (slow-cooked spiced duck) if available, IDR 50,000–70,000.

day_by_day.notes: Penestanan is a hidden gem that most tourists miss — it offers a more authentic and quieter Ubud experience. The Balinese massage is deeply therapeutic and a must-try cultural wellness experience. Negotiate prices gently and always agree on the price before the session begins.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning visit to the Tirta Gangga Water Palace in East Bali (about 1.5 hours from Ubud by scooter). This stunning royal water palace features tiered fountains, koi-filled pools, and lush tropical gardens. Entrance fee: IDR 50,000. Arrive early to beat the crowds.
day_by_day.afternoon: Stop at Taman Ujung Water Palace on the way back (another royal garden near the coast) — entrance IDR 50,000. Then drive along the scenic East Bali coastline before heading back to Ubud. Alternatively, visit the black sand beach at Candidasa for a free swim.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Ubud. Enjoy a quiet evening journaling, stretching, or attending a sunset meditation class at a local studio.

meals.breakfast: Pack a simple breakfast from a warung before departure — banana and peanut butter sandwich or fruit, IDR 15,000–25,000.
meals.lunch: Local warung near Tirta Gangga — fresh seafood or rice dishes, IDR 40,000–60,000.
meals.dinner: Warung in Ubud — simple and satisfying, IDR 35,000–55,000.

day_by_day.notes: The East Bali route is one of the most scenic drives on the island — the road passes through rice terraces, small Hindu villages, and coastal viewpoints. Fuel up your scooter before leaving Ubud as petrol stations are less frequent in East Bali. Carry cash as ATMs are scarce in rural areas.

day_by_day.morning: Join a morning yoga class at Radiantly Alive studio in Ubud — one of the best-value studios with drop-in classes from IDR 120,000. Try a different style today such as Kundalini or Ashtanga. After class, take a cold shower and enjoy a slow morning.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the Blanco Renaissance Museum in Campuhan — a flamboyant museum dedicated to the eccentric Spanish-Balinese artist Antonio Blanco, set in a dramatic hilltop mansion. Entrance IDR 80,000. Walk back along the Campuhan Ridge for free afternoon views.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a free or low-cost cultural event — check the Ubud Community notice board or local Facebook groups for free temple ceremonies, art exhibitions, or community performances happening that evening.

meals.breakfast: Warung near the yoga studio — healthy local breakfast for IDR 30,000–45,000.
meals.lunch: Kafe Ubud or a similar mid-range café for a treat — IDR 60,000–90,000 for a full meal.
meals.dinner: Night market near Ubud center — graze on various local snacks and dishes for IDR 30,000–50,000 total.

day_by_day.notes: The Blanco Museum is a quirky and underrated attraction — the building itself and the garden views over the Campuhan River are worth the entrance fee. Check if there is a traditional ceremony at Pura Gunung Lebah or nearby temples — observing (not participating) in a Balinese ceremony is a profound cultural experience.

day_by_day.morning: Second beach day — this time head to Seminyak Beach or Echo Beach in Canggu for a different vibe. Take an early shared shuttle (IDR 50,000–80,000). Spend the morning swimming and relaxing on the white sand beach. July is dry season so conditions should be excellent.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the beach town on foot — browse the boutique shops and surf stores in Canggu. Visit Tanah Lot Temple (about 30 minutes from Canggu by scooter or taxi) — a dramatic sea temple on a rocky outcrop. Entrance IDR 60,000. Best viewed at low tide when you can walk closer to the temple.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the sunset at Tanah Lot — one of Bali's most iconic sunset spots. Then take a shuttle back to Ubud.

meals.breakfast: Light breakfast before departure from a Ubud warung — IDR 25,000–35,000.
meals.lunch: Beachside café in Canggu — avocado toast or nasi goreng, IDR 55,000–80,000.
meals.dinner: Warung dinner in Ubud on return — IDR 35,000–55,000.

day_by_day.notes: Tanah Lot can be very crowded at sunset — arrive at least 45 minutes before sunset to find a good viewing spot. The temple itself is only accessible to Hindu worshippers but the surrounding grounds and sea views are spectacular. Wear water shoes if you plan to walk on the rocky coastline near the temple.

day_by_day.morning: Pre-dawn start for the Mount Batur sunrise trek! Depart from Ubud around 2:00–3:00 AM by scooter or arranged transport. Join a guided group trek up the active volcano (1,717 m) to watch the sunrise from the summit. Guided group treks cost IDR 300,000–400,000 including a guide, torch, and simple breakfast at the summit.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to Ubud by midday. Rest, nap, and recover from the early morning adventure. Enjoy a long, restorative yoga or stretching session in the afternoon to soothe tired muscles.
day_by_day.evening: Gentle evening walk along the Campuhan Ridge for the last time this trip. Reflect on the journey and enjoy the peaceful green hills. Early dinner and early bedtime to recover.

meals.breakfast: Summit breakfast included with the trekking package — typically boiled eggs, toast, and hot tea/coffee cooked over volcanic steam vents.
meals.lunch: Light lunch at a warung near the hotel on return — soup or light rice dish, IDR 30,000–45,000.
meals.dinner: Warung dinner — keep it light and nourishing, IDR 35,000–55,000.

day_by_day.notes: The Mount Batur sunrise trek is one of the highlights of any Bali trip — the view of the sunrise over the clouds with Lake Batur below is unforgettable. Bring warm layers as the summit temperature can drop to 10°C before dawn. Wear sturdy shoes (not flip-flops). Book the guide the day before through your hotel or a local trekking agency.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning in Ubud. Wake up slowly and do a personal farewell yoga session on the hotel terrace, reflecting on 13 days in Bali. Take one last walk along the Campuhan Ridge to say goodbye to the stunning Ubud landscape.
day_by_day.afternoon: Pack up and check out of the hotel. Depending on your departure flight time, spend remaining time shopping for last-minute souvenirs at the Ubud Art Market — bargain for batik fabric, silver jewelry, wooden carvings, and local spices. Head to the airport with ample time (allow 2–2.5 hours travel time from Ubud to the airport).
day_by_day.evening: Departure from Ngurah Rai International Airport. Reflect on an incredible 13-day budget adventure through Bali's yoga culture, stunning beaches, ancient temples, and lush rice terraces.

meals.breakfast: Final Balinese breakfast at a beloved warung — savor one last nasi goreng or fruit plate, IDR 25,000–40,000.
meals.lunch: Quick lunch near the Ubud market before departure — keep it light for travel, IDR 30,000–50,000.
meals.dinner: Airport or in-flight meal.

day_by_day.notes: Allow extra time for the Ubud to airport transfer as traffic can be unpredictable, especially in the afternoon. Book a reliable shuttle or taxi the night before. Use any remaining Indonesian Rupiah on last-minute snacks, souvenirs, or a final coconut water from a street vendor. Most airports have currency exchange booths if you have leftover cash.

trip_options.title: Classic Bali Experience
trip_options.description: The sweet spot between comfort and value. Enjoy quality accommodations, diverse experiences, and good food.

day_by_day.morning: Arrival at Ngurah Rai International Airport at 13:00 — no morning activities scheduled.
day_by_day.afternoon: Transfer from airport to Campuhan Ridge, Ubud Boutique Stay (~1.5 hrs). Check in, freshen up, and take a gentle stroll along the iconic Campuhan Ridge Walk to stretch your legs and soak in the lush green valley views.
day_by_day.evening: Explore the quiet lanes around Campuhan and Jalan Raya Ubud. Visit the nearby Pura Gunung Lebah temple at dusk for a peaceful introduction to Balinese spirituality.

meals.breakfast: Meal on the plane or at the airport.
meals.lunch: Grab a light bite at a warung near the airport or en route — try Warung Mak Beng style local food.
meals.dinner: Bridges Bali Restaurant, Campuhan — mid-range riverside dining with Indonesian and Western options; budget ~IDR 150,000–250,000 per person.

day_by_day.notes: Keep Day 1 light — focus on settling in and acclimatizing. Stay hydrated after the flight. The Campuhan Ridge Walk is flat and easy, perfect for tired legs.

day_by_day.morning: Start the day with a sunrise yoga class at the Yoga Barn, Ubud (~15 min from hotel). Choose a Hatha or Vinyasa class suitable for all levels. Classes typically run 07:00–09:00.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the Ubud Sacred Monkey Forest Sanctuary and then walk through Ubud Art Market to browse local crafts, textiles, and souvenirs. Bargain respectfully for keepsakes.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a traditional Kecak Fire Dance performance at Pura Dalem Ubud or Arma Open Stage — a quintessential Bali cultural experience.

meals.breakfast: Café Wayan, Ubud — wholesome Indonesian breakfast with fresh fruit, jamu juice, and nasi goreng; ~IDR 60,000–100,000.
meals.lunch: Warung Babi Guling Ibu Oka — famous Balinese suckling pig; ~IDR 50,000–80,000.
meals.dinner: Locavore NXT or Hujan Locale — modern Indonesian cuisine with local ingredients; ~IDR 200,000–350,000 per person.

day_by_day.notes: Book the Kecak Dance in advance (tickets ~IDR 100,000–150,000). Wear a sarong or bring one for temple visits.

day_by_day.morning: Morning meditation and pranayama session at Radiantly Alive Yoga Studio in Ubud (07:30 class). Then visit Pura Tirta Empul temple for a purification water blessing ceremony — a deeply moving spiritual experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the Tegallalang Rice Terraces (~20 min north of Ubud). Walk the terraced paths, interact with local farmers, and enjoy the dramatic landscape. Optional: try the famous Bali Swing for a thrill (~IDR 150,000–300,000).
day_by_day.evening: Return to Ubud. Enjoy a traditional Balinese massage at a local spa (e.g., Ubud Sari Health Resort or Taksu Spa) — ~IDR 150,000–250,000 for 1 hour.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast or Kafe Batan Waru — healthy smoothie bowls and eggs; ~IDR 70,000–120,000.
meals.lunch: Warung di Tegallalang — local warung near the rice terraces with nasi campur; ~IDR 40,000–70,000.
meals.dinner: Mozaic Restaurant Ubud — upscale garden dining; splurge-worthy for a special evening; ~IDR 400,000–600,000.

day_by_day.notes: Tirta Empul requires a sarong and sash (provided at entrance). Arrive early to avoid crowds. The Bali Swing is optional and weather-dependent.

day_by_day.morning: Day trip to Seminyak Beach (~1.5 hrs from Ubud). Hire a private driver for the day (~IDR 400,000–600,000). Arrive mid-morning and enjoy the beach — swim, sunbathe, or try stand-up paddleboarding.
day_by_day.afternoon: Walk along the famous Seminyak beach strip. Browse boutique shops on Jalan Oberoi. Visit Ku De Ta or Potato Head Beach Club for a relaxed afternoon by the Indian Ocean.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the legendary Bali sunset from Seminyak Beach (around 18:15–18:30 in July). Then enjoy dinner in Seminyak before the drive back to Ubud.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast before departure.
meals.lunch: La Lucciola, Seminyak — beachfront Mediterranean-Italian; ~IDR 200,000–300,000.
meals.dinner: Merah Putih Restaurant, Seminyak — stunning architecture, modern Indonesian; ~IDR 250,000–400,000.

day_by_day.notes: Hire a trusted driver through your hotel. Seminyak can be busy; visit the beach early for the best spots. Bring reef-safe sunscreen.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning Yin Yoga class at The Yoga Barn (07:00). After class, visit Pura Saraswati (Lotus Temple) in central Ubud — beautiful lotus pond and ornate temple carvings.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the Ubud Palace (Puri Saren Agung) and stroll through the Ubud Art Market again for any remaining shopping. Visit the Blanco Renaissance Museum for art and culture.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a Legong Dance performance at Ubud Palace — performed in the royal courtyard under the stars.

meals.breakfast: Down to Earth Café, Ubud — organic, plant-based options; ~IDR 80,000–130,000.
meals.lunch: Warung Sopa — vegetarian Balinese cuisine; ~IDR 50,000–90,000.
meals.dinner: Room 4 Dessert — creative Indonesian-inspired tasting menu; ~IDR 300,000–500,000.

day_by_day.notes: Legong Dance tickets ~IDR 100,000. The Blanco Museum entry is ~IDR 80,000. Keep the pace relaxed today.

day_by_day.morning: Day trip to Canggu (~1.5 hrs from Ubud). Visit Batu Bolong Beach — one of Bali's most popular surf spots. Take a beginner surf lesson with a local instructor (~IDR 300,000–450,000 including board rental).
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the trendy Canggu village — visit Echo Beach, browse independent cafés, and check out the vibrant street art scene along Jalan Batu Mejan.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset drinks at Old Man's, Canggu — a legendary beach bar with live music and a buzzing atmosphere. Then drive back to Ubud.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast before departure.
meals.lunch: The Shady Shack, Canggu — plant-based café with great bowls and smoothies; ~IDR 80,000–150,000.
meals.dinner: Crate Café or Deus Ex Machina Café, Canggu — relaxed, mid-range; ~IDR 120,000–200,000.

day_by_day.notes: Book surf lessons in advance during peak season. Canggu can have traffic — depart Ubud by 08:30 to maximize beach time.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery day. Sleep in, then enjoy a slow morning yoga flow on your hotel terrace or in the hotel garden. Take a gentle walk along the Campuhan Ridge Walk at your own pace.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the Neka Art Museum in Campuhan — one of Bali's finest art museums showcasing traditional and contemporary Balinese art. Then enjoy a cooking class at a nearby Ubud cooking school (e.g., Paon Bali Cooking Class).
day_by_day.evening: Relax at the hotel. Optional: join a sound healing or restorative yoga session at The Yoga Barn in the evening.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast — leisurely and relaxed.
meals.lunch: Neka Museum Café or nearby warung — light Indonesian lunch; ~IDR 50,000–80,000.
meals.dinner: Enjoy the dishes you cooked in the cooking class, or dine at Bridges Bali again for a familiar, comfortable evening.

day_by_day.notes: This is your mid-trip recharge day. The cooking class is ~IDR 350,000–500,000 and includes a market visit. Book in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Early start for a trip to Mount Batur for a sunrise trek (~2.5 hrs from Ubud). Depart hotel by 02:30, begin the 2-hour trek to the summit, and watch the sunrise from 1,717m above sea level — a truly unforgettable experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Descend Mount Batur and stop at Lake Batur (Danau Batur) for a relaxing soak in natural hot springs at Toya Devasya Hot Spring Resort (~IDR 150,000 entry). Return to Ubud by early afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: Early dinner and an early bedtime — well deserved after the trek!

meals.breakfast: Simple breakfast provided by your trekking guide at the summit (usually banana, eggs, and toast cooked on volcanic steam).
meals.lunch: Warung near Lake Batur — fresh fish from the lake; ~IDR 60,000–100,000.
meals.dinner: Warung Ibu Oka or a simple local warung near the hotel — light and restorative; ~IDR 50,000–80,000.

day_by_day.notes: Book a licensed trekking guide in advance (~IDR 350,000–500,000 per person). Bring warm layers — the summit is cold before sunrise. Sturdy shoes are essential.

day_by_day.morning: Late morning yoga class (09:30) at Radiantly Alive — choose a restorative or gentle class to recover from the trek. Then visit the Goa Gajah (Elephant Cave) temple — a UNESCO-listed archaeological site just outside Ubud.
day_by_day.afternoon: Drive to Keramas Beach (~45 min from Ubud) — a black sand beach popular with surfers and much less crowded than Seminyak or Canggu. Relax on the beach and watch surfers ride the waves.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Ubud. Enjoy a traditional Balinese foot massage and reflexology session at a local spa; ~IDR 80,000–120,000.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast — light after yesterday's exertion.
meals.lunch: Warung near Goa Gajah — nasi campur; ~IDR 40,000–70,000.
meals.dinner: Alaya Resort Restaurant, Ubud — elegant garden setting, Indonesian and international menu; ~IDR 200,000–350,000.

day_by_day.notes: Goa Gajah entry ~IDR 50,000; sarong required. Keramas Beach has strong currents — swimming is not recommended; it's best for watching surfing.

day_by_day.morning: Day trip to Nusa Penida Island (~2.5 hrs from Ubud including transfer to Sanur port). Take a fast boat from Sanur (~IDR 150,000–200,000 one way). Visit Kelingking Beach — one of Bali's most iconic viewpoints — and Angel's Billabong natural infinity pool.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue to Broken Beach (Pasih Uug) — a stunning natural arch formation. Swim at Crystal Bay if conditions allow — famous for its clear turquoise water and manta ray sightings.
day_by_day.evening: Return fast boat to Sanur, transfer back to Ubud. Arrive by 20:00.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at hotel before 06:00 departure.
meals.lunch: Warung on Nusa Penida — simple local food; ~IDR 50,000–80,000.
meals.dinner: Late dinner at Warung Babi Guling or a nearby Ubud warung on return.

day_by_day.notes: Book fast boat in advance. Hire a scooter or local driver on Nusa Penida (~IDR 150,000–200,000/day). The descent to Kelingking Beach is steep and optional. Bring motion sickness tablets for the boat.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise yoga on the Campuhan Ridge — bring a mat and practice independently or join a guided outdoor session. Then visit the beautiful Pura Luhur Batukaru temple (~1.5 hrs from Ubud) — one of Bali's most sacred and atmospheric temples set in dense jungle.
day_by_day.afternoon: Stop at Jatiluwih Rice Terraces on the way back — a UNESCO World Heritage Site with sweeping panoramic views of ancient rice terraces. Walk the terraced paths (~2 km loop).
day_by_day.evening: Return to Ubud for a relaxed evening. Browse the night market near Ubud central for local snacks and street food.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast or smoothie bowl from a nearby café.
meals.lunch: Warung at Jatiluwih — traditional Balinese set meal; ~IDR 60,000–100,000.
meals.dinner: Night market, Ubud — local satay, martabak, klepon, and fresh juices; ~IDR 30,000–60,000.

day_by_day.notes: Hire a driver for the day (~IDR 500,000–700,000). Batukaru temple requires a sarong. Jatiluwih entry fee ~IDR 40,000. Carry cash for warungs and markets.

day_by_day.morning: Final yoga class at The Yoga Barn — choose your favorite style from the week. Afterward, treat yourself to a full Balinese spa ritual: body scrub, floral bath, and massage at Taksu Spa or Ubud Sari (~IDR 300,000–500,000 for a package).
day_by_day.afternoon: Last-minute souvenir shopping at Ubud Art Market and Jalan Hanoman boutiques. Pick up silver jewelry, batik textiles, wood carvings, or local coffee and spices as gifts.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell sunset walk along the Campuhan Ridge Walk. Reflect on the journey over a special farewell dinner at one of Ubud's finest restaurants.

meals.breakfast: Café Pomegranate or Kafe — healthy, wholesome breakfast; ~IDR 80,000–130,000.
meals.lunch: Warung Sopa — vegetarian Balinese; ~IDR 50,000–90,000.
meals.dinner: Locavore — Ubud's celebrated farm-to-table fine dining; ~IDR 600,000–900,000 for the tasting menu. A worthy splurge for the final night.

day_by_day.notes: Book Locavore well in advance — it is one of Bali's most sought-after restaurants. The spa package should also be booked ahead. Pack your bags tonight for an easy departure.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise walk or gentle stretching on the hotel terrace. Enjoy a leisurely last breakfast. Check out of the hotel and arrange airport transfer (book through hotel; ~IDR 350,000–450,000 to Ngurah Rai Airport, ~1.5 hrs).
day_by_day.afternoon: Depending on flight time, stop at a last café or warung near the airport in Kuta or Seminyak for a final Indonesian meal. Browse Duty Free at the airport for Bali coffee, chocolate, or local crafts.
day_by_day.evening: Depart Bali with wonderful memories of beaches, yoga, culture, and natural beauty.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast — savour the last Balinese morning meal.
meals.lunch: Airport or Kuta warung — nasi goreng or mie goreng for a final taste of Bali; ~IDR 40,000–70,000.
meals.dinner: In-flight meal or at connecting airport.

day_by_day.notes: Allow at least 3 hours before your flight for airport check-in and security. Bali airport can be busy in July. Keep some IDR cash for last-minute tips and small purchases.

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Bali Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

day_by_day.morning: Arrival at Ngurah Rai International Airport at 13:00 — no morning activities scheduled
day_by_day.afternoon: Private airport transfer to Campuhan Ridge, Ubud Boutique Stay. Check in, freshen up, and enjoy a welcome drink on your private terrace overlooking the lush jungle ridge. Take a gentle stroll along the iconic Campuhan Ridge Walk to acclimate to the surroundings and soak in the golden afternoon light over the rice paddies.
day_by_day.evening: Settle into the resort with a sunset cocktail at the hotel's infinity pool bar. Enjoy a leisurely welcome dinner at the hotel restaurant or a short drive to Bridges Bali, a landmark fine-dining restaurant perched over the Campuhan River.

meals.breakfast: Not applicable (in-flight)
meals.lunch: Light snack or meal at the airport or upon arrival at the hotel's welcome spread
meals.dinner: Bridges Bali Restaurant, Campuhan — multi-course contemporary cuisine with river gorge views; reserve the terrace table for a romantic debut dinner

day_by_day.notes: Arrange private airport transfer in advance through the hotel. Keep Day 1 light to recover from travel. Confirm check-in time with the hotel as flight lands at 13:00.

day_by_day.morning: Begin with a sunrise yoga session on the hotel's open-air yoga pavilion overlooking the Campuhan Ridge — many boutique stays in this area offer in-house or partnered instructors. Follow with a nourishing breakfast at the hotel.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the artistic village of Penestanan, a short walk from Campuhan Ridge, known for its painters' colony and traditional Balinese architecture. Visit a local artist's studio for a private art demonstration. Return for a 90-minute traditional Balinese massage at the hotel spa.
day_by_day.evening: Head into central Ubud for dinner at Locavore, one of Bali's most celebrated fine-dining restaurants known for its farm-to-table philosophy and tasting menus. Book well in advance.

meals.breakfast: Full gourmet breakfast at the hotel — fresh tropical fruits, Balinese black rice porridge, eggs to order, fresh juices
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the hotel or a healthy café nearby such as Sayuri Healing Food in Ubud
meals.dinner: Locavore, Ubud — award-winning 7-course tasting menu with optional wine pairing

day_by_day.notes: Book Locavore at least 2–3 weeks in advance as it fills up quickly. Yoga session can be arranged through the hotel concierge.

day_by_day.morning: Private guided sunrise trek through the Campuhan Ridge Walk and surrounding jungle trails. The trail is especially magical in early morning mist. Return for breakfast and a refreshing dip in the hotel pool.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private driver excursion to Tegalalang Rice Terraces (approximately 20 minutes north of Ubud). Enjoy a photography walk through the UNESCO-recognized terraces. Continue to Kopi Luwak plantation for a premium coffee tasting experience.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a traditional Kecak Fire Dance performance at Pura Dalem Ubud or Pura Taman Saraswati temple — a mesmerizing cultural spectacle. Dinner at Hujan Locale, a stylish restaurant celebrating Indonesian archipelago cuisine.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast — smoothie bowls, avocado toast, Balinese-style eggs with sambal
meals.lunch: Alfresco lunch at Swept Away at COMO Uma Ubud or a scenic warung near Tegalalang
meals.dinner: Hujan Locale, Ubud — modern Indonesian fine dining with craft cocktails

day_by_day.notes: Kecak performances typically begin at 18:00 or 19:00; check current schedule with the hotel concierge. Bring a light layer for the evening as ridge temperatures can be slightly cooler.

day_by_day.morning: Morning Vinyasa yoga class at The Yoga Barn, one of Bali's most renowned yoga centers, located in central Ubud. Choose from a variety of styles and levels. Follow with a healthy post-yoga brunch.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private Balinese cooking class with a master chef — learn to prepare traditional dishes such as sate lilit, lawar, and black rice pudding using ingredients sourced from a local market. The class typically includes a market visit in the morning or afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: Relaxed evening at the hotel — enjoy a private couples' spa ritual or in-room aromatherapy treatment. Dine at the hotel restaurant under the stars.

meals.breakfast: Light pre-yoga breakfast at the hotel — fresh fruit, granola, herbal tea
meals.lunch: Dishes prepared during the cooking class served as a celebratory lunch
meals.dinner: Hotel restaurant fine dining or Room service with curated Balinese set menu on the private terrace

day_by_day.notes: The Yoga Barn offers drop-in classes; book in advance for popular morning sessions. Cooking classes can be arranged through the hotel concierge with private chef options available.

day_by_day.morning: Full-day excursion to the beaches of South Bali. Depart early with a private driver to Seminyak or Nusa Dua (approx. 1.5 hours). Check into a day-use suite or beach club for the day at a luxury property such as The Mulia Nusa Dua or Potato Head Beach Club, Seminyak.
day_by_day.afternoon: Afternoon at leisure on the beach — swim in the warm Indian Ocean, enjoy a beachside massage, and sip fresh coconuts. Explore the curated boutiques of Seminyak's Eat Street if energy allows.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cocktails at Ku De Ta or Merah Putih rooftop. Dinner at Merah Putih, an architectural masterpiece serving refined Indonesian cuisine in a stunning bamboo cathedral space.

meals.breakfast: Early hotel breakfast before departure
meals.lunch: Beachside grill at The Mulia Beach Club or Potato Head — grilled seafood, fresh salads, tropical cocktails
meals.dinner: Merah Putih Restaurant, Seminyak — elevated Indonesian cuisine in a landmark setting

day_by_day.notes: Allow 1.5–2 hours for travel each way. A private driver for the full day is recommended. July is peak season in South Bali — book beach club and restaurant reservations in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Recovery morning — gentle restorative yoga or meditation session at the hotel. Enjoy a long, leisurely breakfast. Visit the sacred Pura Gunung Lebah temple at the base of the Campuhan Ridge, a short walk from the hotel.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private silver jewelry-making workshop with a local Balinese artisan in Celuk village (approx. 30 minutes from Ubud). Create your own bespoke keepsake to take home. Visit the woodcarving village of Mas on the return journey.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset at the hotel terrace with cocktails. Dinner at Room4Dessert or Mozaic Restaurant Ubud — Mozaic is a Michelin-caliber tasting menu experience set in a candlelit garden.

meals.breakfast: Full hotel breakfast — eggs Benedict with Balinese spiced hollandaise, fresh tropical juices, artisan coffee
meals.lunch: Lunch at a refined warung or café in Celuk or Mas village during the excursion
meals.dinner: Mozaic Restaurant, Ubud — 8-course contemporary tasting menu with French-Indonesian fusion; extensive wine cellar

day_by_day.notes: Mozaic requires advance reservations and is considered one of Bali's top fine-dining experiences. Dress smart-casual for the evening.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning private driver excursion to Mount Batur for a sunrise trek (depart hotel by 03:30). Guided hike to the 1,717m active volcano summit to witness one of Bali's most spectacular sunrises above the clouds. Cook breakfast eggs in volcanic steam vents at the summit.
day_by_day.afternoon: Descend and stop at natural hot springs at the base of Mount Batur (Toya Devasya Hot Springs) for a relaxing soak. Return to the hotel by early afternoon for a long rest and spa treatment.
day_by_day.evening: Quiet, indulgent evening at the hotel. Private in-room dining with a curated Balinese feast or a gentle dinner at the hotel restaurant.

meals.breakfast: Summit breakfast — eggs cooked in volcanic steam, packed snacks and hot tea provided by guide
meals.lunch: Light lunch at Toya Devasya resort or on the return journey at a scenic lakeside restaurant overlooking Lake Batur
meals.dinner: In-room private dining at the hotel — Balinese rijsttafel (rice table) with multiple dishes

day_by_day.notes: Mount Batur trek requires a licensed guide (mandatory). Depart hotel no later than 03:30 to reach the summit for sunrise. Wear layers as summit temperatures can drop to 10–15°C. Physical fitness required — moderate difficulty.

day_by_day.morning: Leisurely rest morning after the Batur trek. Late breakfast, gentle stretching or yin yoga on the hotel terrace. Visit the Blanco Renaissance Museum in Campuhan — a stunning hilltop museum dedicated to the eccentric Spanish-Filipino artist Antonio Blanco.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private excursion to Tirta Empul, Bali's most sacred water temple, for a guided spiritual purification ritual (melukat). Continue to the Presidential Palace at Tampaksiring for a brief exterior visit and surrounding gardens.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Ubud for a traditional Legong dance performance at Ubud Palace (Puri Saren Agung). Dinner at Alaya Resort's rooftop restaurant or Nusantara by Locavore for Indonesian small plates.

meals.breakfast: Late hotel breakfast — açaí bowls, smashed avocado, Balinese coffee
meals.lunch: Scenic lunch at a restaurant near Tirta Empul such as Puri Mawa Restaurant
meals.dinner: Nusantara by Locavore, Ubud — Indonesian small plates and street food elevated to fine-dining standard

day_by_day.notes: Bring a sarong and sash for the Tirta Empul temple visit (can be rented on-site). The melukat purification ritual is open to respectful visitors. Ubud Palace dances typically start at 19:30.

day_by_day.morning: Full-day private boat charter to the Nusa Islands (Nusa Penida or Nusa Lembongan). Depart from Sanur Harbour (approx. 1 hour from Ubud). Snorkel with manta rays at Manta Point, one of the world's premier manta ray cleaning stations.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the dramatic cliffs of Kelingking Beach (T-Rex viewpoint) and the natural infinity pool at Angel's Billabong on Nusa Penida. Swim in crystal-clear turquoise waters at Broken Beach.
day_by_day.evening: Return by speedboat to Sanur and private transfer back to Ubud. Dinner at a relaxed but refined restaurant in Ubud — Warung Babi Guling Ibu Oka for Bali's legendary suckling pig or Café Pomegranate for a lighter option.

meals.breakfast: Early hotel breakfast before departure
meals.lunch: Fresh grilled seafood lunch on Nusa Lembongan at a beachside restaurant such as Sandy Bay Beach Club
meals.dinner: Babi Guling Ibu Oka, Ubud — Bali's most famous suckling pig institution, a must-try cultural experience

day_by_day.notes: Book a private speedboat charter for the best experience. Bring reef-safe sunscreen, snorkel gear (can be provided by charter), and seasickness medication if needed. Seas in July are generally calm. Kelingking requires a steep hike — wear proper footwear.

day_by_day.morning: Morning Pranayama breathwork and meditation session arranged through the hotel or at The Yoga Barn. Slow morning with a long hotel breakfast. Visit the Ubud Art Market for premium batik, ikat textiles, and artisan crafts.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private luxury spa afternoon at COMO Shambhala Estate — one of Asia's premier wellness retreats, located just minutes from the hotel on the Campuhan Ridge. Book a signature 3-hour wellness journey including body scrub, wrap, and massage.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell pre-final-days dinner at Swept Away at COMO Uma Ubud — elegant open-air restaurant above the Wos River valley with refined Balinese and international cuisine.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast — full spread with Balinese specialties and international options
meals.lunch: Light healthy lunch at COMO Shambhala Estate's restaurant — organic, nutrient-rich cuisine aligned with wellness philosophy
meals.dinner: Swept Away at COMO Uma Ubud — elegant fine dining above the jungle canopy

day_by_day.notes: COMO Shambhala spa treatments must be booked well in advance. The Ubud Art Market is best visited early morning for the freshest selection and less crowds.

day_by_day.morning: Private excursion to the western coast of Bali — visit the black sand beaches of Balian Beach or the surf town of Medewi (approx. 1.5 hours from Ubud). Enjoy a morning surf lesson with a private instructor at Balian Beach, ideal for beginners and intermediates.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the Jatiluwih Rice Terraces, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, with a private guide. The terraces are less crowded than Tegalalang and offer breathtaking panoramic views. Stop at a local family compound for a traditional Balinese blessing ceremony.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Ubud via the scenic mountain road through Batukaru. Dinner at a hilltop restaurant with valley views — Cascades at Viceroy Bali, a stunning infinity-edge pool restaurant with contemporary cuisine.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast before departure
meals.lunch: Lunch at a local warung near Jatiluwih with views over the UNESCO rice terraces
meals.dinner: Cascades Restaurant at Viceroy Bali — contemporary fine dining with panoramic Ubud valley views and infinity pool setting

day_by_day.notes: Jatiluwih requires a small entrance fee. The drive through the Batukaru mountain road is scenic but winding — a reliable private driver is essential. Cascades at Viceroy Bali is a top-tier experience; reserve in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Final full yoga day — book a private 2-hour yoga and sound healing session with one of Ubud's master teachers (the hotel concierge can arrange). Practice on the ridge at sunrise for a transcendent experience. Follow with a long, indulgent hotel breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: Last-minute shopping and gallery visits in Ubud — visit Gaya Ceramic & Design for premium Balinese ceramics, and Threads of Life for ethically sourced traditional textiles. Stop at the Neka Art Museum for a curated overview of Balinese and Indonesian fine art.
day_by_day.evening: Grand farewell dinner at Mozaic Restaurant Ubud or return to Locavore for a final celebration of Bali's culinary excellence. End the night with cocktails at the hotel bar, reflecting on the journey.

meals.breakfast: Celebratory full hotel breakfast — champagne, fresh tropical fruits, Balinese specialties
meals.lunch: Refined lunch at Kafe Batan Waru or Café Lotus overlooking the lotus pond temple in Ubud center
meals.dinner: Mozaic Restaurant, Ubud — final luxury tasting menu dinner with wine pairing in the candlelit garden

day_by_day.notes: Pack bags this evening for an organized departure. Confirm airport transfer time with the hotel. Keep receipts for any high-value purchases for customs declaration.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise on the Campuhan Ridge Walk — a gentle 45-minute stroll to say goodbye to Bali's magical landscape. Return for a last hotel breakfast and check-out formalities.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private transfer to Ngurah Rai International Airport. Depending on flight time, stop at a premium spa in Seminyak or Kuta for a final 60-minute massage before departure — Bodyworks Bali or Jari Menari are excellent options near the airport corridor.
day_by_day.evening: Departure from Bali — carry with you the memories of 13 extraordinary days of beaches, yoga, culture, and luxury.

meals.breakfast: Final hotel breakfast — savor every last bite of fresh tropical fruits, Balinese coffee, and morning views
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the airport's premium lounge or a final meal at a Seminyak restaurant en route to the airport
meals.dinner: In-flight dining

day_by_day.notes: Allow at least 3 hours before international departure for airport check-in and immigration. Store any liquid spa products and fragile souvenirs in checked luggage. The hotel can arrange luggage storage if check-out is before the flight.

query: Bali for solo traveler, $1500 budget, beaches and yoga, July 2026 from LA
